name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jikentan 'Oumagadoki no Kyoushikyoku'
original_name: 探偵・癸生川凌介事件譚「逢魔が刻の狂詩曲」
source:
A request came in to the Kibukawa Detective Agency.

The request came from an old acquaintance of Kibukawa, Daidoji Genzo, who wanted the protection of the Daidoji's treasure, "Tokoyo no Watashi", which had received a notice of theft.
Masao Ikurumi and Izuna Sagishima go to the site in Kibukawa's absence.
There, they become involved in a strange incident involving a hidden treasure.
They were investigating the hidden treasure at the Daidoji house.
Then, they find a strange corpse on a snow-covered road on the property.
What is the end of the story played by the dead body that no one knows...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3090930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
贵生川侦探社收到了委托。

请求来自贵生川的老熟人大道寺源藏，他希望保护收到盗窃通知的大道寺宝藏“常世之渡”。
几留美正夫和鹭岛伊纲在贵生川缺席的情况下前往现场。
在那里，他们卷入了一场涉及隐藏宝藏的奇怪事件。
他们正在调查大道寺宅邸中隐藏的宝藏。
然后，他们在庄园的一条被雪覆盖的道路上发现了一具奇怪的尸体。
无人知晓的尸体所演绎的故事结局将会如何……？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3090930/]Steam[/url]]
